description: This file provides utility functions for filesystem operations such as creating directories, checking if a path exists or is a directory, and reading directory contents recursively, with handling for OS-generated files and exclusions.

methods.name: createDirectoriesForFile
methods.description: Creates all non-existing subdirectories for a given file path and returns an array of created directories.

methods.name: fileExistsAtPath
methods.description: Checks if a given path exists.

methods.name: isDirectory
methods.description: Checks if the given path is a directory.

methods.name: readDirectory
methods.description: Recursively reads a directory and returns an array of absolute file paths, excluding OS-generated files and specified exclusions.
